description: An inactive Fcitx5 (pinyin deactivated, state 1) still takes the QuickPhrase trigger set in conf/quickphrase.conf: Control+Alt+semicolon opens quick phrase input, the typed zzq and 1 select the phrase from a quickphrase.d file (spell suggestions off, so it is the first candidate), and none of those keys reaches the foot probe; only the committed phrase arrives. whykey reads the addon file and names Fcitx5 QuickPhrase. accept handled-uncertain: the daemon's state is that of the most recently focused input context, so whykey cannot tell that the focused terminal is attached to it; the lab shows it was.

whykey.summary: Fcitx5 QuickPhrase TriggerKey opens quick phrase input
